claims.statement: In an exact bounded sweep of 633 canonical hub-tree branch recipes of order at most 18, all 138 lower-region eligible rank rows had saturated deletion-plus-literal-two-for-one weighted transport, with no deficient cut; their directly computed original selected sums were all nonpositive.
claims.scope: Only the family and rank horizon specified in REPORT.md and EVIDENCE.json; a finite mechanism diagnostic, not a universal claim or a resolution of E993-LOWER-REGION-ORDINARY-FAVORABLE-LEAF-AGGREGATE.
claims.reason: Exact integer enumeration and max flow found no bottleneck in the stated family, and direct original-leaf summation matched supply minus capacity. The bounded search supplies no structural argument outside its generation boundary, so the primary remains open.

limitations: The computation covers only canonical hub trees with 2–5 branches of types P1–P4 or C2–C4 and order at most 18.
No universal weighted-cut theorem, injection, or proof of the lower-region aggregate follows from the finite flow certificates.
